The SRC-001-001 extent pp. 5-46 therefore appears to be physically present in a held file. Whether an eighth-impression facsimile satisfies the SRC-001 version identity (which distinguishes impressions and assumes no physical-file identity) and should be registered for SRC-001 / ACQ-2026-10-0427 is a lead decision; this assessment does not treat SRC-001 as held.
